🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 5/11 sectors positive, consistent with internal rotation; leadership is Broad (Top 5 spread across 4 sectors). Communication, Healthcare and Consumer Staples were positive on the week, while Technology, Energy and Financials lagged—no clear style leadership.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Communication led on the week: CHTR (1W: +5.81% | 1M: +40.35%) ABOVE TREND. Healthcare followed, with AMGN (1W: +6.32% | 1M: +5.36%) ABOVE TREND; Consumer Staples also advanced, with EL (1W: +5.35% | 1M: +1.16%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Technology was weakest: AMD (1W: -23.41% | 1M: -27.53%) and ORCL (1W: -8.79% | 1M: -20.42%) BELOW TREND. Energy and Financials also declined; XOM (1W: -1.56% | 1M: -11.58%) and GS (1W: -8.26% | 1M: -12.15%) are BELOW TREND.

📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: F (1W: +7.89% | 1M: +5.19%) ABOVE TREND; HD (1W: +7.00% | 1M: +13.43%) ABOVE TREND; IBM (1W: +6.54% | 1M: -2.04%) RECOVERY; AMGN (1W: +6.32% | 1M: +5.36%) ABOVE TREND; CHTR (1W: +5.81% | 1M: +40.35%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Broad (4 sectors represented); IBM’s weekly gain diverges from its negative monthly return.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: TXN (1W: -7.61% | 1M: -12.11%) BELOW TREND; GS (1W: -8.26% | 1M: -12.15%) BELOW TREND; AMZN (1W: -8.71% | 1M: -3.43%) BELOW TREND; ORCL (1W: -8.79% | 1M: -20.42%) BELOW TREND; CEG (1W: -10.45% | 1M: -9.01%) BELOW TREND. Weakness is concentrated in Technology, with Financials and Utilities also represented.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W moves included F (1W: +7.89% | 1M: +5.19%) ABOVE TREND, HD (1W: +7.00% | 1M: +13.43%) ABOVE TREND and IBM (1W: +6.54% | 1M: -2.04%) RECOVERY. QCOM (1W: +5.54% | 1M: -8.42%) is also in RECOVERY; both IBM and QCOM show short-term bounces, not confirmed monthly strength.

🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Technology was weak overall (1W: -3.31% | 1M: -16.09%; 24 stocks covered; positive-stock count not supplied). AAPL (1W: +0.89% | 1M: +2.52%) is ABOVE TREND, while MSFT (1W: -3.43% | 1M: -7.61%), NVDA (1W: -1.10% | 1M: -31.49%), GOOGL (1W: -3.31% | 1M: -14.81%) and META (1W: -1.05% | 1M: -1.66%) are BELOW TREND.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials declined (1W: -0.90% | 1M: -1.17%; 20 stocks covered; positive-stock count not supplied), with mixed performance among key names. V (1W: +2.21% | 1M: +5.80%) and MA (1W: +2.58% | 1M: +8.22%) are ABOVE TREND; JPM (1W: -2.27% | 1M: -5.67%) and GS (1W: -8.26% | 1M: -12.15%) are BELOW TREND.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare advanced (1W: +1.41% | 1M: +0.52%; 17 stocks covered; positive-stock count not supplied). AMGN (1W: +6.32% | 1M: +5.36%), JNJ (1W: +0.96% | 1M: +2.45%) and LLY (1W: +0.68% | 1M: +8.74%) are ABOVE TREND; UNH (1W: -1.06% | 1M: -15.64%) is BELOW TREND.

🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Keep exposure selective in this NEUTRAL regime: Consumer Staples, Healthcare and Communication showed positive weekly sector returns, while Technology and Energy weakened. Style mixed / no clear leadership; monitor the broad leadership, but avoid treating short-term RECOVERY moves as established trend changes.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: HD (1W: +7.00% | 1M: +13.43%) ABOVE TREND and AMGN (1W: +6.32% | 1M: +5.36%) ABOVE TREND; watch for continued follow-through. BEARISH: AMD (1W: -23.41% | 1M: -27.53%) and ORCL (1W: -8.79% | 1M: -20.42%), both BELOW TREND; monitor whether weakness persists.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Communication (1W: +2.39% | 1M: +11.14%) and Healthcare (1W: +1.41% | 1M: +0.52%) led; overall breadth remains 5/11 sectors positive. BEARISH: Technology (1W: -3.31% | 1M: -16.09%) and Energy (1W: -1.68% | 1M: -11.74%) remain weak.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Actual price levels and recent swing highs/lows were not provided, so specific support and resistance levels cannot be stated reliably. Monitor AAPL (1W: +0.89% | 1M: +2.52%) ABOVE TREND for trend continuation, and AMD (1W: -23.41% | 1M: -27.53%) BELOW TREND for signs of stabilization or further deterioration.

📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
IBM (+45): Wedbush initiated coverage at Outperform; price is RECOVERY, with the positive weekly move diverging from the negative month. META (+38): launched an AI shopping agent in the UK; price is BELOW TREND, so the news has not yet been confirmed by performance.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
AMAT (-55): UBS cut its target and China-curb concerns weighed; (1W: -11.54% | 1M: -21.29%) BELOW TREND, confirming weakness. AMD (-45): downgrade cited valuation concerns; (1W: -23.41% | 1M: -27.53%) BELOW TREND, confirming weakness. ORCL (-35): reports of discounted AI-debt sales; (1W: -8.79% | 1M: -20.42%) BELOW TREND, confirming weakness. F (-40): transmission-defect settlement; (1W: +7.89% | 1M: +5.19%) ABOVE TREND, diverging from the negative headline.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL regime; Breadth: 5/11 sectors positive, with Broad leadership across 4 sectors and style mixed / no clear leadership. HD (1W: +7.00% | 1M: +13.43%) and AMGN (1W: +6.32% | 1M: +5.36%) are ABOVE TREND, showing relative strength. Technology weakness and negative AMD, AMAT and ORCL sentiment are key risks; IBM’s positive news and weekly bounce remain in RECOVERY, not yet confirmed by its monthly trend.
